findings.title: F5 NGINX Out-of-Band Patches — CVE-2026-42530 (CVSS 9.2) HTTP/3 QUIC Use-After-Free + CVE-2026-42055 (CVSS 9.2) Proxy/gRPC Heap Overflow Allow Unauthenticated RCE
findings.affected_technology: F5 NGINX Open Source + NGINX Plus + NGINX Gateway Fabric + NGINX Instance Manager
findings.summary: F5 shipped out-of-band patches for two CVSS-9.2 unauthenticated NGINX RCE flaws (use-after-free in ngx_http_v3_module HTTP/3 QUIC and heap-based overflow in ngx_http_proxy_v2_module/ngx_http_grpc_module when ignore_invalid_headers is disabled); RCE requires ASLR bypass and no in-the-wild exploitation reported yet but NGINX's deployment scale makes patch urgency high.

findings.title: Cisco ISE CVE-2026-20181 (CVSS 9.1) Authenticated-Admin → Root Command Injection + CVE-2026-20190 Hashed-Credential Disclosure Patched; Single-Node Deployments Can DoS
findings.affected_technology: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) + ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) 3.3, 3.4, 3.5
findings.summary: Cisco patched a CVSS-9.1 authenticated-admin HTTP command-injection flaw in ISE/ISE-PIC that escalates to root and can DoS single-node deployments (CVE-2026-20181), plus a high-severity unauthenticated hashed-credential disclosure flaw (CVE-2026-20190); fixes in 3.3 Patch 11 / 3.4 Patch 6 / 3.5 hotfix, no in-wild exploitation observed.

findings.title: ShapedPlugin WordPress Supply-Chain Compromise — CVE-2026-10735 Backdoor In Build Pipeline From 2026-05-21; Product Slider Pro / Real Testimonials Pro / Smart Post Show Pro Paid Updates Shipped LicenseLoader.php Stealer
findings.affected_technology: ShapedPlugin paid WordPress plugins (Product Slider Pro pre-3.5.4, Real Testimonials Pro 3.2.5, Smart Post Show Pro pre-4.0.2) — vendor's free WordPress.org base ~400K active installs
findings.summary: Attackers compromised ShapedPlugin's build pipeline on 2026-05-21 and shipped LicenseLoader.php through legitimate paid-plugin updates for ~3 weeks before customer reports on 2026-06-10; payload steals WordPress creds + 2FA secrets + DB credentials + 3-month WooCommerce order history + SMTP creds, fixes shipped 2026-06-16.

findings.title: Arch Linux AUR Hijack — 400+ Abandoned Packages Adopted Since 2026-06-11; npm 'atomic-lockfile' + bun 'js-digest' Postinstall Pull Rust Infostealer With Optional eBPF Rootkit
findings.affected_technology: Arch Linux User Repository (AUR) — 400+ packages, attacker-adopted abandoned projects
findings.summary: Attackers adopted 400+ abandoned AUR projects from 2026-06-11, edited PKGBUILD/.install scripts to npm-install 'atomic-lockfile' (followed by bun 'js-digest' second wave) which drops a Rust infostealer harvesting browser/Electron/GitHub/npm/cloud/SSH/Docker creds plus an optional eBPF rootkit hiding processes via pinned BPF maps when run as root.

findings.title: Klue OAuth Compromise → 'Icarus' Salesforce CRM Theft Campaign — Dormant Prototype-Integration Credential Abused To Mint OAuth Tokens For Customer Salesforce Tenants
findings.affected_technology: Klue Battlecards Salesforce integration + customer Salesforce CRM tenants connected via OAuth
findings.summary: Huntress and ReliaQuest report Icarus (April-2026 extortion group, alias 'mr bean') exploited a dormant Klue prototype-integration credential to steal customer OAuth tokens then ran Python REST API queries (sometimes ~1K queries in 15 minutes) against /services/data/v59.0/query to exfiltrate contacts/sales comms/quotes — Salesforce disabled the Klue Battlecards integration platform-wide.

findings.title: Operation Endgame SocGholish/FakeUpdates Takedown — 14,971 WordPress Sites Cleaned + 106 Servers/Domains Seized; Evil Corp-Linked Loader Active Since 2017
findings.affected_technology: SocGholish/FakeUpdates/GhoLoader JavaScript downloader on compromised WordPress sites
findings.summary: Dutch NHCTU / Canadian RCMP / US FBI / German BKA with Europol+Eurojust cleaned 14,971 SocGholish-infected WordPress sites and seized 106 servers/domains on 2026-06-18 — the Evil Corp-linked JS loader has dropped Dridex/DoppelPaymer/Empire/Koadic/Chtonic/Azorult since 2017 via fake browser-update lures.

findings.title: Splunk AI Toolkit CVE-2026-20266 (CVSS 9.1) — Authenticated-Admin OS Command Injection Via Unsafe Shell Pattern In btool Configuration Helper
findings.summary: Splunk patched CVE-2026-20266 (CVSS 9.1) — an authenticated-admin OS command injection via unsafe shell pattern in the AI Toolkit btool configuration helper — alongside CVE-2026-20265 medium-severity info disclosure from insecure defaults; both fixed in AI Toolkit 5.7.4.

findings.title: Atlassian 100-Bulletin Quarterly Roll-Up — Critical Third-Party Dep Patches Across Jira/Confluence/Bitbucket/Bamboo (Axios x3, Apache Tomcat x5, Netty x1)
findings.affected_technology: Atlassian Jira / Confluence / Bitbucket / Bamboo (server + data center)
findings.summary: Atlassian published 100 security bulletins on 2026-06-18 patching third-party dependency vulnerabilities across Jira/Confluence/Bitbucket/Bamboo — critical issues in Axios (3 CVEs), Apache Tomcat (5 CVEs) and Netty (1 CVE); no active exploitation reported but the dep-update surface is broad and worth prioritising for internet-facing instances.

noted.summary: avleonov 'In the Trend of VM' #28 (2026-06-17) reports CVE-2026-41091 LPE-to-SYSTEM in Defender Malware Protection Engine with public exploit and in-wild exploitation evidence; distinct from yesterday's 'RoguePlanet' CVE-2026-50656 — strict-scope local-LPE skip, monitoring only.

noted.product: INC Ransomware-as-a-Service Rust rewrite + Veeam DPAPI dumper
noted.summary: THN 2026-06-18 reports INC RaaS has 830+ victims since 2023-08, encryptors rewritten in Rust for cross-platform deployment, and an updated credential dumper targeting Veeam backups with salted DPAPI — backup-server hardening relevant to ransomware recovery posture.

THN 2026-06-18 reports DragonForce-linked Backdoor.Turn conceals C2 traffic inside Microsoft Teams relay infrastructure, dwelling 1–2 months undetected — egress allowlists for *.teams.microsoft.com should now expect Backdoor.Turn lookalike traffic patterns.
No material change vs 2026-06-18 — patch still in development, race condition LPE-to-SYSTEM unchanged; tracking through next Patch Tuesday.

BleepingComputer 2026-06-18 reports the Gentlemen RaaS group is actively developing/maintaining a suite of EDR-killer tools for affiliates — relevant to detection-bypass tradecraft, not a vulnerability per se.

noted.product: USB worm crypto-clipper (LNK propagation + Tor C2)
noted.summary: BleepingComputer 2026-06-18 reports a self-propagating USB clipper malware spreading via Windows .lnk shortcuts with Tor C2 and wallet-address substitution — endpoint USB-policy relevance, low Watchtower scope.

BleepingComputer 2026-06-18 notes Klue proactively disabled integrations with HubSpot, SharePoint, Zoom, Gong and Slack alongside the Icarus Salesforce breach — operational impact to detect/wait on if your team uses Klue Battlecards.

SecurityWeek 2026-06-18: ~8,500 internet-exposed REDCap instances, only 1.18% on latest 17.1.3 — China-linked UNC6508 (Mandiant/GTIG) compromises legacy installs deployed side-by-side with current versions, drops InfiniteRed backdoor and waits months before credential reuse; relevant if any biomedical-research partners run REDCap.

noted.product: Node.js June 2026 security releases (all active lines)
noted.summary: openwall oss-security 2026-06-18 announces Node.js security releases across all active release lines — see nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/june-2026-security-releases for CVE list; check supply-chain build images and Docker base layers for any active-line bump.

noted.product: Linux kernel MediaTek t7xx WWAN driver
noted.summary: openwall oss-security 2026-06-18 reports slab out-of-bounds read in MediaTek t7xx WWAN driver — local-impact only, mostly mobile-modem surface, strict-scope skip.

openwall oss-security 2026-06-18 reports Mojolicious::Sessions::Storable through 0.05 generates session IDs with insufficient randomness — auth-bypass risk for any Perl web apps still on that storage backend.
openwall oss-security 2026-06-18 reports out-of-bounds read in Vim libsodium-encrypted file handling — local-impact, bounded scope.

noted.product: Oracle Coherence CVE-2026-35307 (CVSS 10.0) + WebCenter family CVE-2026-46781/35286/35296 + MySQL Shell CVE-2026-46850
noted.summary: Oracle June 2026 CPU criticals visible in OpenCVE: Coherence RCE (10.0, scope-change), WebCenter Enterprise Capture RMI RCE (10.0), WebCenter Content/Sites HTTP-RCE (9.8), MySQL Shell (9.9) — follow-up triage from yesterday's Oracle CPU noted item; prioritise WebCenter and Coherence for internet-facing instances.

OpenCVE 2026-06-18 shows CVE-2026-38716 (CVSS 9.8) command injection in IR912/IR915 export function leading to remote root — IoT router surface, low installed base in Watchtower-grade fleets but flag for any field-deployed cellular routers.
Cloudflare's 2026-06-18 post details a multi-stage LLM-driven vulnerability-discovery harness with adversarial-review triage loop — defender-tooling reference, not a vulnerability.
